skill.name: docs-review
skill.description: Review documentation changes against the Metabase writing style guide for tone, clarity, structure, links, formatting, and examples.
skill.summary: Review Metabase documentation changes for style, clarity, and useful reader feedback.

content.value_statement: Documentation PRs can drift from the Metabase style guide and create unclear guidance for readers. This skill checks changes for tone, structure, formatting, links, examples, and useful review feedback.
actual_capabilities: Reviews documentation diffs against the Metabase writing style guide.
Flags tone, clarity, structure, link text, formatting, and example quality issues.
Numbers every issue so authors can reference and resolve feedback easily.
Supports local review output when GitHub review tools are unavailable.
Can post grouped, non-blocking GitHub PR review comments when the required MCP tools are available.
limitations: Focuses on documentation Markdown and may not be suitable for product code review.
Depends on access to the Metabase style guide content for complete guidance.
Cannot verify screenshots or commands beyond the available project context.
GitHub comment posting requires the relevant MCP review tools to be available.

use_cases.title: Review documentation pull requests
use_cases.description: Check a documentation PR for style guide violations before it is merged.

use_cases.title: Improve technical writing drafts
use_cases.description: Find unclear headings, formal tone, weak link text, and verbose paragraphs in Markdown changes.

use_cases.title: Standardize contributor feedback
use_cases.description: Produce numbered, actionable issues that contributors can resolve one by one.

prompt_templates.title: Review a docs file
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this documentation file with the docs-review skill and list only issues that would materially improve the reader experience.

prompt_templates.title: Review a documentation diff
prompt_templates.prompt: Use docs-review on the current Markdown diff. Number every issue and include a short suggested fix for each one.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare PR feedback
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this documentation PR with docs-review. If GitHub review tools are available, post numbered comments as one non-blocking pending review.

prompt_templates.title: Audit complex docs changes
prompt_templates.prompt: Use docs-review across all changed documentation files. Group only high-value issues, preserve sequential numbering, and avoid summary-only feedback.

output_examples.input: A Markdown page uses formal wording, a vague heading, and a link labeled here.
output: Issue 1: Formal tone. The sentence can be more conversational and direct.
Issue 2: Vague heading. Rename the heading to state the task or outcome.
Issue 3: Weak link text. Replace here with descriptive link text.

output_examples.input: A PR changes several docs pages with inconsistent lists and unclear command order.
output: Issue 1: Inconsistent list formatting. Use the same list structure for parallel steps.
Issue 2: Commands out of order. Present commands in the sequence readers should run them.

best_practices: Provide the relevant diff or files so the review can cite precise locations.
Ask for material issues only to avoid noisy style feedback.
Keep the numbered issue format when replying to or resolving feedback.
anti_patterns: Do not use it as a general code security or architecture reviewer.
Do not ask it to enforce preferences outside the Metabase style guide without clear instructions.
Do not post PR comments without confirming that GitHub review tools and permissions are available.

faq.question: What does this skill review?
faq.answer: It reviews documentation Markdown for Metabase style, clarity, structure, formatting, links, and examples.

faq.question: Can it post comments on GitHub PRs?
faq.answer: Yes, when the required GitHub MCP review tools are available. Otherwise, it returns issues in the conversation.

faq.question: Does it block pull requests?
faq.answer: No. Its PR workflow uses non-blocking comments so authors can decide which suggestions to apply.

faq.question: Does it review application code?
faq.answer: No. It is designed for documentation review, not code correctness, security, or performance review.

faq.question: Why are issues numbered?
faq.answer: Sequential numbering helps authors discuss, fix, and track specific feedback items.

faq.question: What should I provide for best results?
faq.answer: Provide the changed Markdown files, a diff, or a PR with enough context to judge reader impact.
